The header's prose counts move with it: the fourteen-kind roster at :16 and the kinds-carrying-contracts arithmetic at :55, which names the kinds contributing a kind fact and no clause row — `mcp` joins that list.
The frozen lane's SDK-side program binds `mcp`/`mcpDefaultContract` (:55-:88 pattern) so the byte-compare covers the new row — the derived-not-transcribed proof for this kind.

Shipped by 7a23f814, after this entry was scoped. Its module doc (:10-:14) rests the whole file on the kind crossing the seam "since the kind ships there and the embedded lock does not carry it yet" — that clause is what this entry makes false, so the header states the embedded home instead. The four cases author `mcp` in their own program, so the embedded copy must agree with the SDK's or `kind.admissibility` refuses them: re-verify, and the `coverage.unmodeled-surface` assertion (:282) stays as-is — the advisory retires in UNMODELED-SURFACE-ADVISORY-RETIRES, not here.

Re-baseline the file's premise: its header (:11) and the advisory case (:133) rest on `mcp-server` governing `.mcp.json` whole and on the unmodeled-surface finding as the observable. With the container auto-adopted for every harness, an `.mcp.json` no program declares draws `locus.undeclared-member` instead — the settings analogue 9fcf7521 landed — so the case states what now holds rather than asserting the retiring advisory.

The guard arms that use `.mcp.json` as the co-owned manifest: the locus-exclusion arm (:2008), the contract-finding arms over a `.mcp.json` write (:2245-:2361) and the container-less conformance arm (:2568). Their premise — 'the manifest no container member can project at all' — is lock-relative, not kind-relative: these fixtures' locks declare registration rows only, so the wording restates that, and any arm whose write now draws the undeclared-locus finding moves to a manifest its own lock leaves undeclared.

The corpus itself authors no `.mcp.json` (its diagnostics snapshot lists `mcp-server (0)`), so the expected change is the coverage line's kind census alone — no new corpus member. Touch only if the snapshot re-baseline needs the renderer to move.
The `coverage.checked` disclosure's kind count and per-kind list gain `mcp (0)`.

The corpus's emitted lock renders here; a built-in kind the corpus declares no member for adds no row, so the expected diff is none — declared so the fence does not fail the tick if the regenerated projection moves a byte.
The matrix derives its rows from the embedded lock's kinds, so `mcp` joins as a row with no cell filled — the same shape `installed-plugin` and `known-marketplace` hold.

summary: The engine embeds the `mcp` kind: a bare harness gets `.mcp.json` governed whole, so its residue reaches a row and a hand edit to any part of it is drift.
